title: Pre-registered validation gates (frozen before backtest)
statement: These gates were written and committed to git BEFORE engine/analyze.py was first executed in this session. A strategy must pass ALL gates to enter the leaderboard's rewarded tier. Gates are not modified after results are seen; any change creates a new gate version.

gates.name: Data integrity
gates.rule: Every input row is source-linked to an official nfl.com page; aggregate reconciliation (W-L-T, PF, PA) has 0 mismatches.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Strategy-level ROI claims require >= 300 graded selections; below that the strategy is graded 'insufficient sample' and earns no rewards.

gates.name: Walk-forward only
gates.rule: Every prediction is generated from data strictly before the game date. No future information, no refitting on holdout.

gates.name: Holdout direction
gates.rule: Point estimate beats the naive baseline on the frozen holdout (weeks 8-10 of 2026).

gates.name: Uncertainty
gates.rule: 95% week-clustered bootstrap CI of the improvement over baseline excludes 0.

gates.name: Closing-line test
gates.rule: Strategy must beat the closing line at kick-off on >= 55% of selections. BLOCKED: no official or licensed betting-line archive exists in this repository; gate cannot be evaluated until a rights-cleared price source is ingested.

gates.name: Luck removal
gates.rule: Matched-random placebo test: observed improvement must exceed the 95th percentile of 10,000 label-shuffled placebo runs (p < 0.05).

gates.name: Stability
gates.rule: Improvement sign consistent across two disjoint season splits (weeks 3-6 vs weeks 7-10).

gates.name: Risk discipline
gates.rule: Documented staking (flat or fractional Kelly capped at 0.25); max single selection <= 2% of bankroll; drawdown stop at -15%.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.rule: Deterministic rebuild from committed data; engine/verify_site.py passes (no broken links, every table row source-linked).
